A '''noblewoman''' from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alsakan/Legends|Alsakan]] lived during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], during which she was part of a proposed [[Marriage/Legends|marriage]] alliance with several [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] traders. The alliance would safeguard trade in the Mid Rim for generations, but the noblewoman initially refused to agree to the alliance. A diplomat attempted to reason with the [[Gender/Legends|woman]], only to discover that she was objecting to the terms of the trade agreement. The diplomat modified the terms of the agreement, impressing both the noble and the traders, and the marriage went ahead as scheduled.<ref name="Bound by Trade" />
